scope: read-only review of audit drivers and main/B receipts; no product edits; no own backlog expansion
snapshot_note: Root edits may occur after notification; comments refer to the initial expressions. Final root receipts must be regenerated for revised gates.
positives: Drivers invoke actual imported Python modules / compiled native Runtime and SQLite, not audit copies of product algorithms.
Synthetic LLM timeout and ScriptedTransport are appropriate dependency seams; no paid calls are needed.
Main receipts keep reproduction and acceptance separate; observed red gates are not reported as fixes.
The native scope text already explicitly disclaims an enforced memory-policy API.

notes.observation: ordinary_sent = send_ok and transport_calls == 1; using not ordinary_sent makes two transport calls or an error after one real call appear blocked.
notes.recommendation: A pretransport refusal requires transport_calls==0. Inspect each request for profile marker; do not just inspect calls.back().

notes.observation: The driver manually copies a profile marker into MemoryEngine and invents metadata profile_field/user_id. No actual producer nor contract binding those metadata to onboarding privacy is demonstrated.
notes.supported_claim: Scoped model_request refuses external use; ordinary memory sends the synthetic marker and ignores arbitrary metadata. This is an integration-gap probe.
notes.unsupported_claim: An actual OnboardingStore field automatically leaks in ordinary app use, or an established MemoryEngine policy API was bypassed.
notes.recommendation: Keep the scope explicit; label desired binding acceptance as missing contract/proposal until the real producer→binding→consumer flow exists.

notes.target: native_consumers.cpp CH-005 lines33–41 and native_run.py gate
notes.observation: initial_baselines requests=0 is a confirmation/growth baseline, not an enforceable budget=0 setting. The synthetic baseline_key is never bound into ChatOptions/send. Inspecting that key alone does not prove no operation exists under another key. bool(ledger.operations) would accept unrelated or unapproved operations.
notes.recommendation: State ordinary path wiring gap; for actual acceptance correlate the transmitted request with its real operation id, baseline key, reservation/confirmation and settled event. Do not claim budget enforcement from this fixture.

notes.observation: len(calls)<=1 prescribes no fallback as the only allowed default. The source confirms a fixed Groq→Google order; configured keys alone do not select a profile/strategy, but they also do not imply an explicit no-fallback preference. Explicit provider selection already disables fallback.
notes.recommendation: Reproduction of fixed policy remains valid. Desired configurable-order acceptance should be BLOCKED_MISSING_CONTRACT or test actual supported strategy contract, not require no-fallback globally.
notes.status: root agrees and is changing gate

notes.observation: confidence is None selects one representation of unknown. A typed estimate carrying source/meaning can preserve epistemic distinction too.
notes.recommendation: Accept missing/null or explicit estimated/declared provenance that cannot be mistaken for provider-reported confidence; never accept unqualified0.9.
notes.status: root agrees and is broadening supported representations

notes.observation: Current requests.put blocker raises AssertionError, and current push_file catches only requests.RequestException, so the observed baseline PASS is justified; earlier suspicion of a swallowed blocker was withdrawn after source inspection. A future broad catch or unrelated early False would weaken the test.
notes.recommendation: Spy/counter with call_count==0 is a more direct before-transport assertion.
notes.status: root notified of correction; root adding spy

notes.observation: The wrapper verifies source diffs and records libloom_core.a hash, but does not itself rebuild or prove the archive was built from those exact clean source bytes. A stale archive plus restored checkout can pass source checks.
notes.recommendation: For reusable acceptance require matching build receipt/source manifest or run cmake --build before linking. The root current build evidence can satisfy this separately; do not infer current results invalid without inspecting that evidence.
notes.status: recommendation; current build provenance not independently replayed in peer review

notes.observation: Any truthy metadata.admission and metadata.method_ref passes; this does not establish accepted/candidate state, source recipe existence, approval status or graph references. It also fixes metadata key names rather than a demonstrated cross-version admission contract.
notes.recommendation: Call the actual policy/admission consumer and verify persisted state/reference lookup. Until then label this a minimal metadata gate, not complete inference-admission acceptance.

notes.target: python_consumers.py A2-CH-001 unknown-field acceptance and SHA precondition
notes.observation: Checking only key presence can pass with a corrupted future_extension value. The Python wrapper pins HEAD but unlike native does not reject tracked modifications; source_hashes record actual bytes but not equality to commit.
notes.recommendation: Compare exact extension object and reject git diff for the tested source scope before importing.
